description: Xero Accounting API app emulator, for integrations that bill customers, collect payments, issue refunds and record bank activity: OAuth tokens and connections, organisation, the chart of accounts with account creation, contacts, invoices, payments and credit notes with signed webhook events, bank transactions and manual journals. Deliberate differences from Xero are declared in divergences.json.

resources_not_implemented: behaviour: webhook subscription disable after 24 hours and replay of held events (GAP-001)
behaviour: order and If-Modified-Since on list endpoints are accepted and ignored (GAP-002)
behaviour: summarizeErrors=false on bulk contact writes (GAP-004)
behaviour: POST /Contacts upsert by Name, which Xero does not document (GAP-007)
behaviour: OIDC discovery, the authEventId filter on GET /connections and DELETE /connections/{id} are not served (GAP-008)
behaviour: GET /Contacts/{ContactID or ContactNumber} is not served (GAP-009)
behaviour: contact fields in an invoice update, sent flag for PAID documents, allowBackorders and the default document date are not built (GAP-010)
behaviour: rate-limit headers and 429, the payroll 401 and XML responses are not built (GAP-011)
behaviour: a webhook receiver that sets cookies is not refused (GAP-012)
behaviour: tax is not computed on bank transactions and manual journals, so a line's TaxAmount is the amount sent, or 0, as on invoices (GAP-013)
behaviour: where on GET /Accounts is accepted and ignored, so the whole chart is returned (GAP-014)
behaviour: overpayment and prepayment bank transactions create no Overpayment or Prepayment record and so emit no webhook event for one (GAP-015)
behaviour: a manual journal line whose account code matches no account is refused, not removed with a Warning as the spec's example shows (GAP-016)
behaviour: IsReconciled on a bank transaction is a stored flag only, with no bank statement lines or reconciliation behind it (GAP-017)

behaviour: an unknown BankTransactionID or ManualJournalID in a batch POST /BankTransactions or /ManualJournals answers 404 for the whole batch and writes nothing, where Xero's answer is unsettled under quirk crud-022 (GAP-018)
behaviour: POST /BankTransactions/{id} and POST /ManualJournals/{id} apply the first item of an envelope and ignore any others (GAP-019)
behaviour: a where equality test on a path a list does not read, such as Contact.Name on BankTransactions, matches nothing and answers 200, not an error (GAP-020)
behaviour: PUT or POST of an empty BankTransactions or ManualJournals array answers 200 with an empty array and writes nothing (GAP-021)
behaviour: a paged list on an empty tenant reports pageCount 1 (GAP-022)
behaviour: PUT /Accounts refuses the wrapped {"Accounts":[...]} body and reads only the bare account the spec documents (GAP-023)
behaviour: an unknown BankTransaction Status on create is replaced by AUTHORISED, not refused (GAP-024)
behaviour: an account of Type PAYG gets Class LIABILITY by inference from its name (GAP-025)
behaviour: the validation messages for an off-spec BankAccountType, CurrencyCode, line Taxability or LineAmountTypes, and for a PUT /Accounts body that is not one object, are guesses (GAP-026)

behaviour: a spec CurrencyCode sent on a new bank transaction is overwritten by the bank account's currency when that account has one, and one sent on an update is ignored, the bank account's currency winning when it has one (GAP-027)
behaviour: unitdp is ignored on GET /BankTransactions and GET /BankTransactions/{id} (GAP-028)
behaviour: a manual journal line on a bank account, or with a zero amount, is accepted, and Xero's behaviour for either is unverified (GAP-029)

behaviour: a CurrencyCode outside the spec enum is refused with a guessed message on invoice and credit note creates and updates and on bank transaction creates, where Xero's answer is unobserved (GAP-030)
behaviour: an empty LineAmountTypes on an invoice or credit note update becomes Exclusive, where keeping the stored value or refusing would also be defensible (GAP-031)
behaviour: contact enum values outside the spec are refused on PUT and POST /Contacts with guessed messages, and a payment term with no Type is refused, where Xero's answer is unobserved (GAP-032)
behaviour: an InvoiceAddressType other than FROM or TO is refused on invoice and credit note creates with a guessed message, and updates ignore InvoiceAddresses (GAP-033)
behaviour: a request body, or a record in its envelope, that is not a JSON object is refused on every write route with a guessed message (GAP-034)
behaviour: Status or Options sent on a manual journal line's Tracking item are dropped, as the line's Tracking is stored in the line-item tracking shape (GAP-035)
behaviour: a manual journal update with an empty LineAmountTypes is refused while a create defaults it to NoTax, unlike the Exclusive default on invoices and credit notes (GAP-036)
behaviour: an empty CurrencyCode on an invoice or credit note update is stored and omitted from the response, silently clearing the currency (GAP-037)

lifecycle.changelog:
Follow-up to b24aeed25cff, released 2026-11-03. It adds account creation, bank transactions and manual journals, and refuses writes the official SDK cannot read back. It targets the Xero Accounting API (addressed as version 2.0), pinned to the official xero-python 15.2.0 SDK and the 19.0.0 Accounting OpenAPI specification, with Xero's developer documentation as captured on 2026-09-28. This release is targeted: it serves 29 routes, not the whole API.

### What changed since b24aeed25cff
- Accounts: PUT /Accounts creates an account, so an integration can add the account it books to. The type, class, bank account type and currency are checked against the spec
- Bank transactions: create (PUT), list and read by ID (GET), update and delete (POST /BankTransactions/{id}), and update-or-create (POST), with line items, a contact by ContactID, and a Reference that round-trips
- Manual journals: create (PUT), list and read by ID (GET), update (POST /ManualJournals/{id}) and update-or-create (POST), with a balance check on the journal lines
- Behaviour change: a write that carries a value outside the spec enums is now refused with a 400 on accounts, contacts, invoices, credit notes, bank transactions and manual journals. The earlier build stored it, and every typed read in xero-python then failed until the store was reset. The same holds for a request body that is not a JSON object
- Behaviour change: the Bearer scheme in the Authorization header is matched without regard to case

### Supported
- Sign-in: authorization-code exchange, client credentials and single-use refresh-token rotation at POST /connect/token, and GET /connections
- Organisation and chart of accounts (read and create)
- Contacts: list with where filters, create (PUT) and update-or-create (POST), with field validation
- Invoices: list and read by ID or invoice number, create (PUT), update, void and delete (POST), update-or-create (POST), and summarizeErrors=false
- Payments: create (POST) against an invoice or a credit note, and delete by status write
- Credit notes: list, create (PUT) with inline allocations, and update-or-create (POST) including allocations
- Bank transactions and manual journals, as listed above
- where filters, the explicit list filters the SDK sends, and page-based pagination on the list endpoints
- Signed webhook delivery for contact, invoice and credit note events, with the intent-to-receive check; subscriptions are registered through /admin/webhooks. Writes to accounts, bank transactions and manual journals send no event
- A xero-tenant-id header on every accounting route, a lenient default that accepts any bearer token, client secret, authorization code and redirect URI, and --strict-auth to restore Xero's 401 and 403 answers and to check clients registered through /admin/clients and single-use authorization codes issued through /admin/authorization-codes
- State snapshots, reset and seeding through /admin, with /_xero/health and /_xero/reset as aliases for the health and reset routes

### Verified
- Official SDK xero-python 15.2.0: 41 of 41 cases against this build
- Conformance suite: 10 of 10
- Through LocalStack: not run for this build
- Live comparison with Xero: not run

### Not modelled
- Operations and behaviours outside the list above are not served. twin-xero/twin-manifest.json lists the 53 unserved operations and the behaviours that are not built or are built differently, and every deliberate difference from Xero is listed in twin-xero/divergences.json

### Known issues
- Inferred from the SDK and documentation, not observed on Xero: the credit note update rules, how POST update-or-create matches an existing record, allocations against an invoice that is already PAID, payments on credit notes, and the messages for the new enum refusals
- Tax is not computed: a line's TaxAmount on an invoice, bank transaction or manual journal is the amount sent, or 0
- GET /Accounts ignores where and returns the whole chart
- A bank transaction of type overpayment or prepayment creates no Overpayment or Prepayment record, and IsReconciled is a stored flag with no bank statement behind it
- A manual journal line whose account code matches no account is refused, where Xero's spec example removes it with a Warning
- A batch POST of bank transactions or manual journals that names an unknown ID answers 404 for the whole batch and writes nothing
- The Idempotency-Key header is ignored, so a retried write creates a duplicate where Xero replays the first response
- The order query parameter and the If-Modified-Since header are accepted and ignored on list endpoints: every record is returned in the default order
- A failed webhook delivery is retried a fixed number of times and then dropped; a subscription is never disabled and missed events are not replayed. Each delivery carries one event, with eventType in upper case, and Xero's batching and casing are not settled
- Rate limits are not modelled: there is no 429 answer and no X-DayLimit-Remaining or X-MinLimit-Remaining header
- The 404 and 405 answers for a path or method the emulator does not serve, and the wording of the ValidationException for a value of the wrong type or a date that cannot be read, are not observed on Xero
- A contact array with an invalid item is refused as a whole, even with summarizeErrors=false
- Not served: OIDC discovery, the authEventId filter and DELETE /connections/{id}, GET of a single contact by ID or number, GET of a single account, bank transfers, prepayments and overpayments
